Restructuring Plan – During the quarter, the Company began executing the previously announced restructuring plan to accelerate its path to profitability and sharpen its focus on Building Intelligence.

The Company commenced a reduction in force in August 2026, which is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026, and on October 30, 2026, completed the sale of certain assets of its DOOR Property Management business as part of its planned exit from property management operations.

The restructuring plan is expected to generate approximately $10 million to $12 million in annualized operating cost savings, allowing the Company to concentrate resources on its core Building Intelligence platform, AI-enabled software capabilities, and continued product innovation.

The Company expects further improvement in cash utilization during the fourth quarter of 2026, with improvements accelerating throughout 2027 as the benefits of its restructuring initiatives and other operational efficiencies are realized.

While the first quarter typically includes elevated cash requirements due to the timing of annual payments, the Company expects the combined benefits of these initiatives to drive meaningful improvements in cash utilization, with a goal of achieving positive cash flow by the second half of 2027.
This outlook incorporates the $1.0 million civil penalty associated with the Company’s previously disclosed SEC settlement.
